data.title: Coffee with Esme
data.transcript: Speaker 1: It's been ages! Esme Whitlock; we overlapped at the old job. Speaker 2: Esme! How's Quillon Analytics? Speaker 1: Good, but I'm looking to move. Is your team hiring? Speaker 2: We are, actually. I'll introduce you to our hiring manager this week. Speaker 1: That would be wonderful. Oh, and you have to read The Salt Archive; it's the best novel I've read this year. Speaker 2: I'll look it up. We should do this more often. Speaker 1: We really should.
